description: Customer asks for tracking information, expected delivery date, or any update on an existing order.
examples: Where is my order?
Can you give me the tracking number for my package?
When will my package arrive?

description: Customer reports a problem with how the package was delivered (wrong location, left outside, unsafe, damaged, etc.).
examples: My parcel was left in the mud outside my door.
The courier delivered to the wrong address.
I received a damaged package.

description: Customer wants to return an item, is asking about a refund, or is disputing a return claim.
examples: I want to return this item, can I use the label?
When will I get my refund for the returned order?
My return claim was denied, what can I do?

description: Customer questions a charge, sees an unexpected fee, or has billing‑related problems.
examples: Why was I charged an extra $1 on my purchase?
I was billed for shipping even though I'm a Prime member.
My credit card was charged twice for the same order.

description: Customer experiences problems with Amazon services or devices (apps, video, wish list, etc.).
examples: Amazon Video won't load on my TV.
The Kindle app gets stuck on the initializing screen.
If I set up a wish list, will my address be visible to others?

description: Customer reports a defect, missing parts, or that the received product does not match expectations.
examples: The suitcase I received is broken.
My order is missing one of the three items I bought.
The product I got is not the model I ordered.

description: Customer expresses dissatisfaction, accuses Amazon of misconduct, or threatens legal action.
examples: Your delivery service is terrible and always late.
I will sue you for the unprofessional behavior of your support team.
Why does Amazon ignore my complaints about fake deliveries?
